name: agy-bridge
description: Use Google's Antigravity CLI (`agy`) from Claude Code: offload bulk reads read-only and get a short cited answer back, delegate tasks, review the current diff, ask for a second opinion, and optionally run the work on the Claude models agy offers, on your Google plan instead of your Claude subscription. Model names come from `agy models` at runtime. Forked from simplybychris/antigravity-plugin-cc.
